tasks.short: Prepare, maintain and review neurological patient records

steps.what: Identify the actual patient record and collect and verify the source history, examination, plan and outcome material for this update
inputs: Existing care records and neurologist's actual clinical observations in the clinical record system, defined as OPS_SYSTEM
outputs: Verified source material and explicit gaps for the record update

steps.what: Stage exact selected existing history fields, dates and result identifiers into the draft patient-record update
inputs: Specific source fields verified in s1
Explicit field mapping preserving provenance and dates
outputs: Staged draft fields with source links and missing data marked

steps.what: Author the actual new history, neurological findings, treatment-plan wording and outcome update
inputs: Verified sources and explicit missing-data questions
outputs: Neurologist-authored substantive record update

steps.what: Review the complete final patient-record update against actual sources, observations and decisions, correcting clinical meaning and provenance
outputs: Exact checked complete record update

steps.what: Save the exact checked patient-record update
inputs: Exact complete update checked in s4
outputs: Updated patient record with its actual status

tasks.design: Configure native {OPS_SYSTEM} source-field staging and verbatim dictation into existing record sections. The neurologist authors all clinical content and checks the entire final update, including meaning and provenance, before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual field transfer and typing can duplicate already available facts and clinician-authored wording.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record links, forms and verbatim dictation can reduce transfer and keystrokes without inferring clinical findings.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing current findings, historical facts and actual treatment decisions requires clinical review.
tasks.human_edge: Own the clinical content and identify misleading or incomplete documentation.

ambition.what: Improve existing record preparation and maintenance.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native clinical record fields and verbatim dictation can reduce exact-field transfer and typing while clinicians retain content authorship and full final review.

assumptions: Conditional record-update episode where exact source fields are transferred manually and clinical wording is typed; no measured baseline or universal mix of all record reviews.

Care staff and clinicians produce original sources in actual care work; neurologist source collection and verification are in s1 and new substantive capture and wording in s3. No free pre-authored note or ambient clinical summary.

Native functions first. Existing imports, case links, templates and dictation are baseline and earn no new saving. Missing fields stay manual; no inferred findings, stale carry-forward or automatic treatment-plan decision.

s3's reduction is solely fewer keystrokes through verbatim clinician dictation, retaining content creation and correction. No semantic summarization or unverified transcript becomes a clinical record; all clinical meaning is checked in s4.

Same-system save is negligible and fully retained. No automatic prescription, test order, care instruction send or external release is hidden. Actual clinical decision work remains in its clinical task and earns no saving here.
All 100 illustrative focal effort points: gross 30 plus 9 equals 39, less upkeep 4 gives net 35. Any reused note work across adjacent tasks is counted once.
unknowns: Current native record links, dictation coverage and actual manual entry effort
research_questions: Which exact transfers and typing remain after current clinical-record features, including correction time?

already_counted.description: Source verification, retained substantive clinical authoring and complete final meaning/provenance review

incremental.description: Validate native field mappings and maintain dictation vocabulary and record-section settings

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete patient-record update checked in s4; any edit requires recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional manual record assembly and typing scenario: gross 39 less upkeep 4; all clinical authorship and full final review retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Communicate patient conditions and care to other professionals

steps.what: Find and verify the actual patient context and the other professional's care question
inputs: Existing patient records in the clinical record system, defined as OPS_SYSTEM
outputs: Checked context and communication purpose

steps.what: Determine the actual clinical message about the patient's condition and care, including uncertainties and any clarification with colleagues
inputs: Actual clinical findings and care decisions
outputs: Neurologist's clinical message and limits

steps.what: Write the actual professional handoff message and matching case communication entry
outputs: Complete draft handoff and matching case entry

steps.what: Check the complete final message, case entry, actual recipient and appropriate information scope
outputs: Exact checked final handoff and matching case entry

steps.what: Send the exact checked handoff to the intended health care professional
inputs: Exact final message and recipient checked in s4
outputs: Sent clinical handoff through the existing authorized channel

steps.what: Save the exact checked matching communication entry with actual sent status
outputs: Saved case communication entry

tasks.design: Configure native {OPS_SYSTEM} case views and fixed handoff identifiers. The neurologist determines and writes the clinical message, checks both complete artefacts and the recipient, then separately sends and saves them.
tasks.previous_blocker: Case navigation and repeated identifiers can interrupt professional communication.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case-linked views and handoff forms can reduce navigation and fixed-field entry.
tasks.still_hard: Clinical relevance, uncertainty and communication scope require judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Decide what the colleague needs and convey its clinical implications accurately.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native clinical case views and forms can support fixed-field handoff preparation while clinical message authorship remains human.

assumptions: Representative written handoff to a professional outside the immediate organization through an existing authorized channel, with an actual matching case entry; not a universal baseline for live colleague conversations.

Care owners produce original records; neurologist context checking, message reasoning and actual writing are counted in s1-s3. s3 reduces only repeated fixed identifiers, not clinical prose or reasoning.
Native configuration first; existing case links and forms earn no new saving. Missing facts remain manual; no generated clinical message or new external connection.
The complete final message and entry exist before s4. Any wording, scope or recipient change requires rechecking. No prescription, referral order or treatment command is silently executed.
Send and same-system save are retained without saving. If saving and sending already share one native transaction, do not invent a separate manual baseline. Deduplicate shared record work with 17119.
All 100 illustrative focal points: gross 3 plus 3.5 equals 6.5; upkeep 1.5 gives net 5.
unknowns: Actual written versus live communication mix and native handoff features
research_questions: Which navigation and fixed identifiers remain manual in actual professional handoffs?

already_counted.description: Context checking, complete clinical message reasoning, retained actual writing and full final recipient/content check

incremental.description: Maintain native case view and fixed handoff fields

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete handoff and recipient checked in s4; changes require recheck
Exact matching case entry checked in s4 plus actual send status only

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional written-handoff lookup and identifier saving 6.5 minus upkeep 1.5; clinical reasoning, prose and sends retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Counsel patients on neurological disorders and risk factors

steps.what: Find and verify actual patient context and existing clinician-approved disorder information relevant to the counseling
inputs: Existing patient records in the clinical record system, defined as OPS_SYSTEM
outputs: Checked context and relevant source material

steps.what: Counsel the patient or others on neurological disorder background, risk factors and genetic or environmental concerns
inputs: Verified context and relevant disorder information
outputs: Human counseling, patient questions and actual understanding checks

steps.what: Capture the actual required counseling note and check its complete clinical content and case identity
inputs: Actual discussion and patient concerns from s2
outputs: Complete checked counseling note

steps.what: Save the exact checked counseling note
outputs: Saved actual counseling record

tasks.design: Use native {OPS_SYSTEM} context views and {DOCS} source links, plus fixed case fields for an existing counseling note. The neurologist retains counseling and actual note capture and checks the complete note before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated context navigation and case identifiers can consume preparation and recording effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and forms can reduce that navigation and fixed-field entry.
tasks.still_hard: Patient concerns, risk interpretation and understanding require individual clinical communication.
tasks.human_edge: Listen and explain uncertainty in terms the patient understands.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native clinical views and note fields can support lookup and identifiers while counseling and substantive record capture remain human.

assumptions: Conditional counseling episode with an actual required case note, not a report added to every informal conversation or a measured baseline.
Care and information owners produce existing sources; neurologist context checking and actual discussion capture remain in s1-s3. No generated risk conclusion or clinical explanation.
Native configuration first; existing equivalent views and case fields earn zero saving. s3 reduces identifiers only, retaining substantive writing and complete final checking.

Save is negligible and fully retained. No patient-information send, test order or treatment action is hidden; any actual send must be separately checked and gated. Deduplicate same note work with 17119.
All 100 illustrative focal effort points: gross 3 plus 0.9 equals 3.9, less upkeep 1 gives net 2.9.
unknowns: Actual note practice and current case-linked views
research_questions: Is any repeated context navigation or identifier entry left after native features?

already_counted.description: Retained context checking and actual counseling-note capture and final verification

incremental.description: Maintain native context links and fixed case fields

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete counseling note checked in s3; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional lookup and identifier saving 3.9 less upkeep 1; live counseling and clinical content retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interpret neuroimaging results in the actual clinical case

steps.what: Verify patient identity, actual imaging study, available images and clinical question
inputs: Existing neuroimaging viewer and image archive, defined as OTHER
outputs: Verified study and clinical context with missing evidence marked

steps.what: Examine the actual MRI, SPECT or PET results and images using the existing viewer
outputs: Neurologist's actual image observations and findings

steps.what: Interpret the neuroimaging results in clinical context and determine what conclusions and limitations they support
outputs: Neurologist's interpretation and uncertainties

steps.what: Write the actual interpretation in the clinical record and check the complete wording and source-study identity
inputs: Actual human interpretation and source study
outputs: Complete checked interpretation record

steps.what: Save the exact checked interpretation record
outputs: Saved human interpretation

tasks.design: Retain existing {OTHER} image access and viewing and {OPS_SYSTEM} interpretation recording. No new clinical image-analysis mechanism is proposed; the neurologist examines, interprets, writes and checks the actual record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Interpretation depends on the actual images and clinical context.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing viewers already provide image access; that runtime is baseline, with no demonstrated new labour-removing change here.
tasks.still_hard: Image meaning and clinical significance require specialist judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Integrate the study with the patient and express uncertainty accurately.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: existing imaging viewers support access while clinical interpretation and substantive recording remain specialist work; no new saving follows merely from their existence.

assumptions: Illustrative interpretation episode with an actual clinical record, not measured baseline. Source verification, image examination, clinical interpretation, actual writing and save are separated before assigning zero saving.
Imaging staff produce the study and existing image interfaces already deliver it. Neurologist case verification is counted in s1; no free new image extraction or structured diagnostic feed.

Existing viewers, record links and any dictation or fixed fields are already baseline in this episode. No unsupported manual import or typing burden is invented; no AI image interpretation is proposed.
Same-system save is negligible and fully retained. Any actual report send, referral or treatment command must have a separate exact final-version check and action; none is silently performed.
Actual same-record writing is counted once with 17119. All 100 focal effort points remain; gross and net saving zero, incremental work explicitly zero because no change is proposed.
unknowns: Actual image-record interface and any remaining manual transfer
research_questions: Does observation reveal a separate manual transfer that existing native interfaces do not already handle?

already_counted.description: Case/source verification and actual interpretation writing and full final checking

incremental.description: No new process or software maintenance

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete clinical interpretation checked in s4; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Full decomposition retains existing viewing, clinical judgement, actual record writing and negligible saving; no supported new change removes labour.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

skills_to_grow: Check dictation and complete clinical meaning
role.ambitious_version: The neurologist uses native tools for demonstrably manual record work while retaining diagnosis, counseling, imaging interpretation and clinical communications.
